title: Harnesses
review: One machine-local reconcile composes folder trust, Codex checkout/lane hook trust, unattended posture, one machine-wide yoke allow entry per harness (kept operator modes stay; doctor passes kept-mode-plus-allowed and fails yoke-not-allowed; uninstall removes exactly the entry) and machine hooks. Setup, install/refresh, lane preparation and doctor reuse it. Relay home-list changes trigger all registered checkout and lane targets without creating absent harness homes; facet refusals preserve files and teach recovery. Each posture problem names the file it was read from, so doctor and reconcile never label a settings problem with the Desktop config. The public installer forwards --skip-harness-permissions to the yoke setup it starts or names. Session posture can verify Claude CLI/Desktop and Codex/Cursor CLI readers only; other named surfaces report HARNESS_POSTURE_UNVERIFIED and route to support rather than borrowing CLI settings or recommending a setup repair as proof. Machine-level saved settings do not prove an active in-session approval mode. Source tests prove late installation, byte-idempotence and backoff; receiving-harness proof remains a release check.
